title: Adobe reports AI visitors drove 83% more revenue per visit on U.S. retail sites in September
content:
X author: @sengineland

Adobe released data showing AI visitors generated 83% more revenue per visit on U.S. retail sites in September 2026, up from parity the prior year, along with holiday season forecasts.
